name: Lucy Guo
tagline: Scale AI co-founder and CEO of creator platform Passes
bio: Lucy Guo is a US citizen who works in artificial intelligence. She is the daughter of electrical engineers who emigrated from China. As a child, she taught herself to code so she could adopt virtual pets in the game Neopets. Forbes lists her as a self-made billionaire, with a net worth of $1.45 billion on its real-time list.

She studied computer science and human-computer interaction at Carnegie Mellon, then left to become a Thiel Fellow. In 2016 she launched Scale AI, a data-labeling company, with cofounder Alexandr Wang. She left Scale in 2018 after a falling-out with Wang, but she still owns roughly 3% of the company, which is the source of most of her fortune.

In 2022 she founded Passes, a creator platform, and she serves as its CEO. The company has raised $50 million. In June 2025, Meta bought 49% of Scale AI for about $14 billion, and Scale paid its shareholders a large dividend. From April to December 2025, she was ranked as the world's youngest self-made woman billionaire.
treaty_note: Under the proposed treaty, a net worth of $1.45 billion is $0.45 billion above the one billion dollar cap. That excess is about $450 million, which would leave her a billionaire.
